generation.polygonRepresentation: schema v2 components; each component has one outer ring and an array of preserved holes

japanSpatialJoin.referenceScope: all ADM2 municipalities within supported prefectures; only exact mapped station codes are visit-eligible

koreaCityReference.source: pinned mixed KOR ADM1 and ADM2 polygons
koreaCityReference.referenceScope: eight metropolitan or special cities at ADM1, other municipalities at ADM2, and whole Jeju at ADM1; exact station locations win, then reviewed exact-city KOTRIS modes provide fallback evidence
koreaCityReference.modeFallbackScope: city-specific KOTRIS modes only; national, airport, capital-region, province-wide, and other multi-city modes are excluded

chinaCityReference.referenceScope: the source catalog retains all 368 exact bundled T-Union peer-level cities plus reference-only Macau; CardBal displays the 352 current independent participation boundaries plus Macau, and Taiwan is outside scope
chinaCityReference.visitEligibility: current exact T-Union boundaries and 53 explicitly reviewed non-stacked historical aliases; nine province-wide, historical multi-city, or composite codes resolve only at Province level
chinaCityReference.landClipOrder: Nominatim administrative geometry intersected with pinned Natural Earth land before local RDP, then intersected again after RDP before final quantization
chinaCityReference.postQuantizationContainment: every output ring must stay within a 0.000008-degree land envelope; this bounds coordinate-rounding drift to about 0.9 meters at the equator
chinaCityReference.smallIslandRendering: generated geometry removes detached secondary components smaller than 10 km in both dimensions; the client performs no component filtering

supportedBoundaryPruning.scope: only boundaries referenced by current T-Union participation or station mappings

generation.referenceLineRepresentation: deduplicated shared-border linework, simplified and spatially batched at generation time

boundaryOptimization.overlapScope: same country within this catalog; city and province levels remain separate
boundaryOptimization.overlapWinner: smaller spherical-area boundary, then lexical boundary id
boundaryOptimization.simplification: polygon masks retain repaired source geometry; only the deduplicated reference-line display LOD is simplified
boundaryOptimization.inputFootprintContainment: output is clamped to the bundled input footprint; upstream Natural Earth land containment is not independently revalidated by this optimizer

referenceLines.representation: deduplicated shared-border linework, simplified and spatially batched at generation time
